forecast.generalSituationZh: 受強烈東北季候風及一道雲帶影響，未來一兩日廣東沿岸相當清涼，內陸地區早晚寒冷。隨著覆蓋廣東的雲帶在星期六轉薄，該區日夜溫差較大，早上仍然相當清涼。而一股達強風程度的偏東氣流會在下週初影響華南沿岸，該區雲量增多，氣溫稍為回升。預料另一股東北季候風會在下星期二抵達華南沿岸，下週中期該區將再度轉涼及有幾陣雨。
forecast.generalSituationEn: Under the influence of an intense northeast monsoon and a band of clouds, the weather will be rather cool over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be cold in the morning and at night over inland areas. With the band of clouds covering Guangdong thinning out on Saturday, the temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large over the region. It will still be rather cool in the morning. A strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China early next week. It will be cloudier with temperatures rising slightly over the region. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China next Tuesday. It will become cool again with a few rain patches over the region midweek next week.

days.weatherZh: 氣溫進一步下降。多雲，天氣相當清涼，有幾陣雨。
days.weatherEn: Temperatures will fall further. Cloudy and rather cool with a few rain patches.
days.windZh: 北至東北風4至5級，離岸及高地間中6級。
days.windEn: North to northeast force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.

days.weatherZh: 漸轉天晴乾燥。早上相當清涼。
days.weatherEn: Becoming fine and dry. Rather cool in the morning.
days.windZh: 北至東北風4級，初時5級，高地間中6級。
days.windEn: North to northeast force 4, force 5 at first, occasionally force 6 on high ground.

days.windEn: East force 5, force 6 offshore and on high ground.

days.weatherEn: Cloudy with one or two light rain patches.
days.windZh: 東風4級，初時5級，離岸及高地間中6級。
days.windEn: East force 4, force 5 at first, occasionally force 6 offshore and on high ground.

days.weatherZh: 多雲，有幾陣雨。稍後氣溫下降。

days.windZh: 東風4級，漸轉吹北風4至5級。
